title: Snake Cave
desc: Shipwrecked survivors reach a mysterious island, only to discover it is home to enormous snakes and ancient creatures, forcing them into a desperate fight for survival.

title: No Entry
desc: A gorgeous club dancer's ill-timed rendezvous opens up a Pandora's box of lies, absurdities and misunderstandings in the lives of three quirky couples.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
desc: Jaya marries Keshav but is disappointed to learn that there is no toilet in his house. As a result, Keshav tries to pacify her with temporary arrangements.

title: Chakra Ka Rakshak
desc: A police officer and soldier team up and decide to end the cybercriminals that pose a threat to the safety of people on the Internet.

title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
desc: Bhaijaan, the eldest of three siblings, refuses to get married to maintain harmony in his family. However, complications arise after his brothers conspire for him to fall in love.

title: Farrey
desc: Brought up in an orphanage, child prodigy Niyati gets admitted into a prestigious school. Soon, surrounded by money, she gets engulfed in a cheating racket.

title: Rahu Ketu
desc: Ravi, a CBI inspector, goes undercover to a remote town in order to investigate the rising suspicious deaths. However, things become complicated when he gets arrested by the local police.

title: Tholi Prema
desc: Fate offers Aditya and Varsha the opportunity to rekindle their youthful romance years after personality differences compelled them to go their separate ways.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: When stars misalign, love blossoms between an astrology-obsessed idler and a headstrong fish heiress whose father will settle for nothing less than a hardworking son-in-law.

title: Karan Arjun
desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.

title: Shivam
desc: Shiva is a carefree lad who helps couples in love marry. Soon, he finds his own heart stolen, while being pursued by enemies determined to break them apart.

title: Mr. India
desc: Hoping to make the world a better place for orphaned children, a compassionate street musician takes on a power-hungry crime boss with the help of a cloaking device.

title: Hello Charlie
desc: Charlie, a young man, is tasked with transporting a gorilla to Diu, unaware that it is a fraudster in a costume. Chaos erupts after Charlie encounters a real gorilla on their journey.
